stem: The transition from the second paragraph (sentences 3--9) to the third paragraph (sentences 10--15) is weak. Read both paragraphs again. Which sentence could best replace sentence 10 and improve the transition between these two paragraphs?

options.label: A
options.text: Suddenly it was obvious that we all had a lot that we needed to talk about.

options.label: B
options.text: This stranger had given us cash, something our family had been without for a very long time.

options.label: C
options.text: Soon we began talking about what the note had instructed us to do: pay it forward.

options.label: D
options.text: We wanted to think of some unusual ways to help others.
